Name: Tractor Mod - Vietnamese Translation
Author: nguyen1612
Description:
It changes the interface of Generic Config Menu of the Tractor Mod to Vietnamese so you can use it easier, whether Vietnamese is your first or second language like me.

You should install the tractor mod first,  then paste this directly into the Mods folder.

Words and phrases in the mod has been translated based on my knowledge and a friend of mine (He's 18, so do I) so you might have to consider whether to download this mod or not (it's a bit dirty). The account that uploaded this mod belongs to my friend. I'm just a foreigner who loves Vietnam and the language.
